label: A key for a new customer
description: Data graph behind customer.nextId under the production profile: a key no customer of the store has, asked for before the customer is made, so the domain holds the whole record before anything is written. The same graph as @customers/data/next-id.graph.json, against the store kept in PostgreSQL: a store is named statically at a call site, so pointing these at another connection is a copy until a profile may swap one.
